fields.statement: At 15e6a4da, with a fresh build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) and RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset: rhiza workflow check plan-bug and check bugfix exit 0 (valid, each with only the expected warning about autonomous runs with bypassed permissions); workflow describe plan-bug shows '(repo)' .rhiza/workflows/plan-bug.toml, includes plan, autonomy plan/accept/ship/signoff auto; describe bugfix shows '(repo)', includes build, review, ship-change, all autonomy auto; workflow ls lists bugfix and plan-bug as repo from .rhiza/workflows. make self-check in a clean detached worktree at 15e6a4da exits 0 (in the run checkout it fails only on render of the verifier's own untracked actor record). Diff read: .rhiza/dispatch.toml sets [request] bug = "plan-bug" and [ready] bug = "bugfix" with no schedules; each workflow is one kind = "workflow" step with autonomous = true; no intake script, eventCommand hook or issue label added.
